english.title: Use a goods vehicle without a test certificate

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) This offence wording applies to any goods vehicle over 3500kgs gross vehicle weight. For the similar offence in relation to vehicles under this weight limit see CJS Code RT88096 and Standard Offence Wording H35.
